question_text: How can you implement a queue with an array?
ref_text: Use a circular array. Keep the rear of the queue toward the end of the array, and the front toward the beginning, and allow the rear pointer to wrap around.

subject: public_benchmark
question_text: How can you implement a queue with a list?
ref_text: Keep the rear of the queue pointing to the tail of the linked list, so the enqueue operation is done at the end of the list, and keep the front of the queue pointing to the head of the linked list, so the dequeue operation is done at the beginning of the list.
